note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on release communication, audience-specific messaging, translating Salesforce's own seasonal release notes for an org's users, training, and post-launch adoption tracking. This is general enterprise change-management and organizational-communication practice applied to a Salesforce release context -- per the course brief, general governance practice does not require external verification, and this lesson makes no specific Salesforce feature, API, or numeric claim. No screenshots used per this course's conceptual/architecture policy.
